prompt: This class has a compile error. Why?
choices: A class cannot implement two interfaces with the same method
Dog must provide one speak() implementation — and that single method satisfies both interfaces
speak() has different return types in Animal and Pet
Dog must declare which speak() it implements
explanation: When two interfaces declare the same abstract method signature, the implementing class provides one method that satisfies both. There is no conflict because the signatures are identical. The compile error is the missing implementation: add 'public void speak() { ... }'
